rules.title: Helping Those in Danger
rules.markdown:
## Rule 1 – Helping Those in Danger

**1.1** A boat or competitor shall give all possible help to any person or vessel in danger.

**1.2** (a) A boat that retires shall notify the race committee at the first reasonable opportunity.

(b) When a boat requests redress because of injury or physical damage resulting from giving help, she shall comply with rule 62.

rules.title: Fair Sailing
rules.markdown:
## Rule 2 – Fair Sailing

A boat and her owner shall compete in compliance with recognized principles of sportsmanship and fair play.

rules.title: On Opposite Tacks
rules.markdown:
## Rule 10 – On Opposite Tacks

When boats are on opposite tacks, a port-tack boat shall keep clear of a starboard-tack boat.

rules.title: On the Same Tack, Overlapped
rules.markdown:
## Rule 11 – On the Same Tack, Overlapped

When boats are on the same tack and overlapped, a windward boat shall keep clear of a leeward boat.

rules.title: On the Same Tack, Not Overlapped
rules.markdown:
## Rule 12 – On the Same Tack, Not Overlapped

When boats are on the same tack and not overlapped, a boat clear astern shall keep clear of a boat clear ahead.

rules.title: While Tacking
rules.markdown:
## Rule 13 – While Tacking

After a boat passes head to wind, she shall keep clear of other boats until she is on a close-hauled course.

rules.title: Avoiding Contact
rules.markdown:
## Rule 14 – Avoiding Contact

A boat shall avoid contact with another boat if reasonably possible.

However, a right-of-way boat need not act to avoid contact until it is clear that the other boat is not keeping clear.

rules.title: Acquiring Right of Way
rules.markdown:
## Rule 15 – Acquiring Right of Way

When a boat acquires right of way, she shall initially give the other boat room to keep clear, unless she acquires right of way because of the other boat's actions.

rules.title: Changing Course
rules.markdown:
## Rule 16 – Changing Course

**16.1** When a right-of-way boat changes course, she shall give the other boat room to keep clear.

**16.2** In addition, when after the starting signal a port-tack boat is keeping clear by sailing to pass to leeward of a starboard-tack boat, the starboard-tack boat shall not change course if as a result the port-tack boat would immediately need to change course to continue keeping clear.

rules.title: On the Same Tack; Proper Course
rules.markdown:
## Rule 17 – On the Same Tack; Proper Course

If a boat becomes overlapped within two of her hull lengths to leeward of a boat on the same tack, she shall not sail above her proper course while they remain overlapped within that distance.

rules.title: Mark-Room
rules.markdown:
## Rule 18 – Mark-Room

Rule 18 applies between boats when they are required to leave a mark on the same side and at least one of them is in the zone.

**18.2(a)** When boats are overlapped the outside boat shall give the inside boat mark-room.

**18.2(b)** If boats are not overlapped when the first of them reaches the zone, the boat clear astern shall thereafter give mark-room.

(See full rule text in official rule book for complete clauses.)

rules.title: Room to Pass an Obstruction
rules.markdown:
## Rule 19 – Room to Pass an Obstruction

Rule 19 applies between boats at an obstruction except when it is also a mark the boats are required to leave on the same side.

rules.title: Room to Tack at an Obstruction
rules.markdown:
## Rule 20 – Room to Tack at an Obstruction

A boat may hail for room to tack and avoid a boat on the same tack.

She shall give the hailed boat time to respond.
